Pass
Paste a CSV export from a supported loot addon, or from this addon's own export - the header says which, and the whole file goes in at once. The box only shows the start of it. A very large paste freezes the client for a few seconds while it arrives. Commas and semicolons both work; tab-separated text does not, because a paste into the game loses its tabs.
